students_not_assign_external_grades_disj.description: A user who is a Student attempts to assign an external grade. Even if another role or broad policy would allow assignment, this student-membership case should be excluded.

faculty_only_non_conflicting_assign_exte.description: A user who is both Faculty and TeachingAssistant requests to assign an external grade. A faculty-only floor would require permitting this, conflicting with the source statement that teaching assistants must not assign external grades.

A user who is both Faculty and Student requests to assign an external grade. A broad faculty-only floor would require permitting this, conflicting with the approved student external-grade assignment prohibition.

teaching_assistants_not_assign_external_.description: A user who is both Faculty and TeachingAssistant attempts to assign an external grade; the TA prohibition should exclude this request even though faculty may assign external grades in non-conflicting cases.

teaching_assistants_non_student_assign_i.description: A user who is both TeachingAssistant and Student attempts to assign an internal grade. A broad TA floor would require permitting this request, conflicting with the source statement that students must not assign grades.

students_not_assign_internal_grades_disj.description: A user who is both a Student and a TeachingAssistant attempts to assign an internal grade. The TA floor permits only non-student TAs, and this disjointness ensures the student no-assign-grades rule is not bypassed through role overlap.
